pattern.en: He said that he was tired.
He told me that he was tired.
Can you tell me the time?

text.ru: tell почти всегда требует адресата — кому сказали: tell me, tell her, tell the team. say — без адресата, важны сами слова: say hello, say yes, say that… Если всё-таки нужен адресат с say — через to: She said to me… Устойчивые: tell a story, tell a joke, tell the truth, tell a lie, tell the time — всегда tell.
text.en: tell needs a person: tell me, tell the team. say focuses on the words: say hello, say that… (with a person: say to me). Fixed: tell a story, a joke, the truth, a lie.
text.es: tell + persona (tell me); say + palabras (say hello). Fijas: tell a story, the truth, a lie.

head: say
tell
rows: a story, a joke, the truth, a lie

exercises.en: She ___ me about her new job.
exercises.ru: Она рассказала мне о новой работе.

prompt.ru: Перескажите, что вам сказал коллега: с say и с tell.
prompt.en: Report what a colleague said: once with say, once with tell.
prompt.es: Cuenta qué te dijo un colega: con say y con tell.

exercises.sample: He said the build was ready. He told me to check it.
